verdict.rationale: Recurly documents an extensive API surface covering subscriptions, usage-based billing, entitlements, invoices, dunning, imports/exports, plus official SDKs in 7+ languages (recurly-docs-13,16,17,20,21,23), showing broad functional parity for core billing operations. However, several UI-centric Recurly Engage capabilities (visual Tour builder, Preview Tool for visual editing of prompts/segments/trackers) are described as configured directly in a UI/dashboard with no explicit API equivalent stated, and there is no explicit vendor claim of full UI/API parity anywhere in the pack. Missing for 10: an explicit parity statement, API endpoints for Engage's visual tools (Tours, Preview Tool), and independent confirmation that no UI-only features exist.
